t: This Fortress Trade multi-surface primer undercoat is a versatile water-based solution designed for professional decorators and property maintenance teams. It effectively seals porous substrates and improves paint adhesion, optimising the overall performance and longevity of subsequent top coats. With a quick-drying formula, it is touch dry in just two hours, allowing for efficient project turnaround on both interior and exterior walls and wood. The matt white finish provides an excellent foundational layer, ensuring a smooth and durable surface for painting in various trade applications.
b: Suitable For Both Interior & Exterior Walls & Wood
